notes: Backend limitation. No user name resolution API. Owner approved (Q-S3-007: A).

notes: Warning shown to users. Segment mode is default and 100% reliable.

notes: Preprod API scope restriction. Error state with Retry is correct UX.

notes: Legacy data from before strict enforcement. Does not affect new transfers. May confuse stock reports.

title: display_qty string causes TypeError in arithmetic operations
notes: POS API returns display_qty as string. Arithmetic without Number() wrapper caused toFixed() TypeError. Fixed by wrapping in Number().

title: Duplicate Ingredient Selection Allowed in Recipe & Sub-Recipe BOM
notes: CLOSED: Added .filter() to exclude already-selected ingredient IDs from dropdown options. Verified 49→48→47 count reduction. Owner signed off 2026-06-14.

title: Push status '125 items behind' is misleading (push-form API gap)
notes: UNBLOCKED: G-023 resolved. Backend now returns push_summary with total_behind + status + breakdown. Frontend needs to read push_summary instead of manual computation in StoreManagement.jsx.

title: Stock Inventory should split FG (Outward) / RM (Inward)
notes: Owner approved unfreeze of screenVisibility.js for this change. Add RM Stock under Inward, default Outward to FG.

title: "Unknown: —" in From/To on Store Detail Recent Transactions
notes: Wire existing useRestaurantMap hook. API returns from_restaurant_id/to_restaurant_id — resolve to names via map.

title: Remove 'Adjust Stock' from Operations Hub Quick Actions
notes: Card-only removal. Route and component kept on disk. No frozen file touch needed.

title: Unnecessary 'Direct Stock Entry Disabled' gate page — auto-redirect to PO
notes: Auto-redirect in AddStockPurchaseForm when require_po_for_purchase=true. Covers all entry points without touching frozen files.

title: Dollar sign ($) icon should be Rupee (₹) across app
notes: Replace DollarSign import with IndianRupee from lucide-react in 4 files. Text values already show ₹ correctly.

title: Production Run layout → Master-Detail (owner confirmed Option B)
notes: Full rewrite of ProductionRunForm.jsx (~628 lines) from vertical to master-detail (30/70 split). All BOM/cost/FEFO logic preserved. Mock at /__dev/previews/RUN_PRODUCTION_LAYOUT_COMPARISON.html.

title: Food edit popup → Side Sheet (owner confirmed Option C)
notes: Replace Dialog with Sheet component for food edit. Table stays visible, edit form slides in from right. Quick Info shows linked recipe + FG stock. Mock at /__dev/previews/FOOD_EDIT_PATTERN_COMPARISON.html.

title: Raw Material Master — Sub-recipe items/categories contaminating Ingredients view
notes: 5 sub-issues FIXED: (1) Filtered sub-recipe items from list, (2) Hidden 'Sub Recipe' from category dropdowns, (3) Hidden from Categories tab + replaced delete with toggle, (4) Filter dropdown auto-resolved, (5) 'Used In' column counts recipe+sub-recipe usage. QA 15/15 PASS.

title: Raw Material Master — Consumption & Days of Stock calculation wildly incorrect
notes: FIXED: Switched from purchase-history-based consumption to daily-consumption-report API. Uses display_qty for stock. Normalizes units (gm→kg). QA PASS.

title: Purchase Order Create — Sub-recipe contamination + UX issues (search, cheapest, rate, columns, vendor selection)
notes: 9 sub-issues FIXED: sub-recipe filter, search field, cheapest rendering, Expected Rate read-only, vendor picker for no-history, column renames, tooltip. QA PASS.

title: Raw Material Master — Consumption still 0.0 kg/day (ingredient_id join mismatch with consumption API)
notes: Residual from BUG-027 fix. daily-consumption-report returns ingredient_id that doesn't match inventory_master_id from stock-inventory. Whole Wheat Flour: 0.0 kg/day, 3116d. Need to join by ingredient_name fallback or investigate ID mapping.

title: PO Create — Residual: send rate=0 to API, display_qty not cal_quantity, consumption/DoC wrong, search missing on By Item Need
notes: 6 sub-issues: (2a) Expected Rate display-only, always send 0 to API for both modes, (2b) Stock shows cal_quantity (29865 kg) not display_qty (29.87 kg), (2c) DoC shows 995d — same consumption bug, (2d) Search bar only on By Vendor not By Item Need, (2e/2f) Same display_qty+DoC on By Item Need.

title: RM Stock page — Remove All/FG tabs (RM only), hide Sub Recipe from category filter
notes: 2 sub-issues: (3a) /inventory?type=raw should only show Raw Materials tab — remove All(75) and Finished Goods(31) tabs, (3b) Categories filter dropdown shows 'Sub Recipe (31)' — should be hidden.

title: Stock Inventory expanded row — Expiry Risk inline date, hide Adjust Stock, load FEFO segments
notes: 3 sub-issues: (4) Expiry Risk column shows 'View detail' — should show closest batch expiry date inline, (5a) Hide 'Adjust Stock' quick action button from expanded row, (5b) Expanded row shows 'No segments' but full detail has FEFO segments — load segments in expanded view.

title: Stock Inventory Quick Actions — Dispatch/Wastage don't pre-select ingredient
notes: 2 sub-issues: (6a) Clicking Dispatch from expanded row should pre-select the ingredient on DirectDispatchForm, (6b) Clicking Record Wastage should pre-select the ingredient on WastageEntryForm. Navigation state needs to carry inventory_master_id + stock_title.

title: Sub-Recipe Master — Delete button → Active/Inactive toggle (backend API pending)
notes: Replace red 'Delete' button with active/inactive toggle switch (same pattern as Categories tab BUG-026 fix). Backend flag needed — API will be provided later. UI stub with toast.

title: Production History — Consumed Ingredients Qty shows dash, should show batch total with unit normalization
notes: 2 sub-issues: (8a) Ingredient-level Qty shows '—' but batch-level shows 1000.00 — should sum batches and show total at ingredient level without expanding, (8b) Normalize units when summing across batches (e.g. gm+kg → kg).

title: App-Wide Consumption Unit Mismatch — gm values displayed/calculated as kg (causes 1000x over-ordering in PO Create)
notes: 4 bug sub-classes: (1) .toFixed(1) precision truncation, (2) gm value with kg label + unit-mismatched calculations in PO Create, (3) parseFloat/Number unit stripping in Dispatch/Request/Production, (4) ambiguous unit scale in StockInventory expanded row. Root cause: POS API returns consumption in base unit (gm/ml) but frontend uses display unit (kg/ltr) without conversion. Related: BUG-029, BUG-030, G-020.

title: Food Categories Not Showing — getFoodCategories() doesn't extract r.data.categories
notes: RESOLVED — POS API now returns categories as direct array (was {categories:[...]} during initial investigation, fixed backend-side). Code Array.isArray(r.data) works correctly. Closed 2026-07-10.

title: PO List — Items Column Empty (Backend Gap: no item count in list API)
notes: POS API purchase-order/list has no line_count/items_count field. Transfer history has both. Backend gap — no frontend fix without N+1 calls. Workaround: hide Items column or show item_total.

title: PO Create Item Need — Can't Select Non-History Vendors (dropdown limited to purchase-history vendors only)
notes: When vendorOptions.length>0, Select only shows history vendors. Other vendors excluded. Related: BUG-028 (fixed no-history case, this is partial-history case). Fix: merge vendorOptions + all vendors in dropdown.

title: Store Management — Indirect Outlets (Grandchildren) Show No Detail Info
notes: HK Outlet North/South are grandchildren (belong to Master Stores). franchise/list returns direct children only. Merged outlet objects have hardcoded email:'' and no phone/address/vendor. Stock health stuck on 'Loading'.

title: Transfer Detail FROM Block Empty — restaurantMap Missing Parent for Outlet Users
notes: CR-033 added restaurantMap lookup but map only has children. Outlet users see '—' for parent-sent transfers. Backend gap: detail API missing from/to_restaurant_name (history API has them). Fix: enhance restaurantMap to include parents via hierarchy-detail.restaurants[].

title: Consumption Report — Current Stock Shows Parent's Qty for Child Store Rows
notes: stockLookup built from logged-in user's getStockInventory(). In hierarchy view, child rows resolve to parent's stock by name. HK Express Olive Oil shows 36.1kg (parent) instead of 1.98ltr (child). Fix: use row.closing_stock in multi-store mode.

title: PO Create — Qty Input Allows Negative Values
notes: Input type=number without min=0 at lines 527,678. User can type -13. Filter excludes negatives from submission but UI allows it. Fix: add min=0 + clamp in onChange.

title: PO Lifecycle — Payment Info Visible Before Receive (Should Only Appear at Receive Goods)
notes: Owner requirement: Payment dropdown + Total should NOT appear during create/draft/approved/sent. Only at Receive Goods. Exception: By Vendor items page shows 'Expected Total' header (Qty x Expected Rate reference). Review step: remove Rate/Total/Payment. PO List: hide Payment+Total for pre-receive statuses. PO Detail: hide for non-received. Remove payment_type from create API payload.

title: Pending Queues — No Dispatched/In-Transit Tab for Sender to Track Sent Stock
notes: After dispatching, transfer disappears from sender's view. API returns dispatch_pending field (unused). Need 5th tab showing dispatched-but-not-received transfers where user is sender. CODE NONE — new tab needed.

title: Addon Recipe CRUD Broken — Create/Save/Delete All Fail (missing fields + wrong ingredient format + no delete reason)
notes: 4 sub-issues: (1) Recipe Name doesn't auto-fill from selected addon, (2) Payload missing preparation_time/serves_people, (3) Ingredient keys use ingredient_id/ingredient_qty/ingredient_unit but API expects id/qty/unit, (4) deleteAddonRecipe missing reason body. Related to BUG-046 (same pattern for regular recipe, already fixed).

title: Receive Transfer Fails — INVALID_STOCK_DATA (destination_inventory_master_id NULL, hierarchy not linked)
notes: POS receive endpoint returns 400 INVALID_STOCK_DATA because assertValidStockData() rejects negative cal_quantity on destination. Ooty Tea Powder (18528) has cal_qty=-12 on child (815). Controlled test: Mangalore Coffee (cal_qty=0) received OK on same hierarchy, same mechanism. Fix: allow negative destination cal_qty in assert — the math is self-correcting (-12 + received). Stuck transfers: 307, 309.
